symbols.name: NchooseK
symbols.pod:
@b = NchooseK($N, $K); Selects $K random nonrepeating elements in the range 0 to $N-1.
This is a wrapper for random_subset($K, 0 .. $N - 1);

symbols.name: shuffle
symbols.pod: @b = shuffle($i); Returns the integers from 0 to $i-1 in random order. Note: this can be reproduced with the function @b = random_subset($n, 0..$n-1);
